_comment: iOS public symbol -> its HarmonyOS (ArkTS, harmony/classifymenu) counterpart. Symbols not listed get a 'TODO: N/A on HarmonyOS' status from the rules, each with its reason. Generator: scripts/harmonyos-api.py.

implemented.CYLTagListView (CYLConfiguration) -apply: `configuration` (`@Prop @Watch('reload')`): a new value reloads the list
implemented.CYLTagItemAnimation: item key `animation` (`asset:<rawfile>` or Lottie JSON text; `CYLLottieIcon`)
implemented.CYLMenuStyleImageSize: style key `imageSize` (`"{w, h}"` or a number)
implemented.CYLMenuStyleAdjustsFontForContentSizeCat: `fontSize` in fp: follows the system font scale
implemented.CYLTag.title: `CYLTagItem.title`
implemented.CYLTagListView.foldControl: the section's fold control (`CYLTagListFold-<section>`, localized label)

rules: UIView
a UIKit category; ArkUI has no categories, the counterparts are component attributes
UIButton
a UIKit category; ArkUI has no categories
UIImage
a UIKit category; ArkTS uses ResourceStr images
NSArray
a Foundation category; ArkTS arrays are plain
NSDictionary
a Foundation category; the configuration is JSON text
CYLCollectionViewLeftAlignedLayout
a UICollectionView layout; ArkUI Flex (wrap) lays out the tags, leading-aligned
UICollectionViewDelegateLeftAlignedLayout
a UICollectionView layout delegate; ArkUI Flex lays out the tags
CYLCollectionViewCell
a UICollectionView cell; each ArkTS tag is a Row
CYLTagListCell
a UICollectionView cell; each ArkTS tag is a Row
CYLTagFoldCell
a UICollectionView cell; the ArkTS fold control is a Text in the section header
CYLTagCreateCell
the "+ new tag" cell; tag creation is not in the ArkTS list (no HarmonyOS example creates tags)
CYLIndexPathButton
a UIButton subclass of the cells; ArkTS tags are Rows
CYLRightImageButton
a UIButton subclass; ArkTS lays out image and title in a Row
CYLTagButton
the UIButton of a tag (sizing, players); ArkTS sizes Rows by content and plays CYLLottieIcon
CYLTagFoldButton
the UIButton of the fold control; ArkTS uses a Text with a localized accessibility label
CYLFilter
the UIViewController / XIB filter screen; the HarmonyOS example builds its filter sheet (bindSheet) from CYLTagListView
CYLMultipleFilter
the UIViewController / XIB filter screen; the HarmonyOS example builds its filter sheet from CYLTagListView
kMultipleFilter
keys of the XIB filter screen's settings; the HarmonyOS example saves its filter itself
CYLClassifyMenuViewController
the UIViewController classify menu; the HarmonyOS example's Classify page is CYLTagListView over the shared database
CYLTagView
the older XIB tag view; the HarmonyOS port has CYLTagListView only
CYLTagGroup
a model of the older XIB tag view; the HarmonyOS port has CYLTagListView only
CYLTagModel
a model of the older XIB tag view; the HarmonyOS port has CYLTagListView only
CYLTagCell
a cell of the older XIB tag view; the HarmonyOS port has CYLTagListView only
CYLTagHeaderCell
a cell of the older XIB tag view; the HarmonyOS port has CYLTagListView only
kDataSource
keys of the older data source; the configuration is JSON
CYLImageTag
image tags (pins on a photo) are not ported: no HarmonyOS example shows them
CYLMenuDataSource
an Objective-C data source protocol; the ArkTS list takes the JSON configuration
CYLTagDataSource
an Objective-C data source class; the ArkTS list takes the JSON configuration
CYLMenuDelegate
a delegate callback without an ArkTS counterpart (the list has onTagTap and onSelectionChange only)
CYLMenuResources
a bundle API; ArkTS resources are module resources ($r, resourceManager)
CYLMenuImage
a bundle image lookup; ArkTS uses $r('app.media.…')
CYLMenuFoldControl
fold control options beyond the section's fold toggle are not in the ArkTS configuration subset
CYLMenuFold
fold styles beyond truncation are not in the ArkTS configuration subset
not in the ArkTS configuration subset of CYLTagListView; no HarmonyOS example uses it
